──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Next Steps:

  • Install an agent:      codemie install <agent>
  • Run an agent:          codemie-<agent>
  • Run a quick task:      codemie --task "your task"
  • Install framework:     codemie install <framework>
  • Initialize framework:    codemie-<agent> init
  • Explore more:          codemie --help
